message.content: {"items":[{"title":"ALLBUS 1980 (German General Social Survey 1980)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13325","justification":"Includes West and (in some modules/weights or in combination with parallel East German surveys) comparative attitudes toward family, work, and gender roles around 1980; useful as a Western comparison frame for studies of gender roles in the GDR in the early 1980s."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1982 (German General Social Survey 1982)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13326","justification":"Contains questions on family, employment, and role distribution between men and women, providing an early‑1980s Federal Republic benchmark dataset that many GDR‑focused gender projects use for comparison; relevant when juxtaposed to contemporaneous GDR surveys on gender roles."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1984 (German General Social Survey 1984)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13327","justification":"Covers attitudes to work, family and gender norms in mid‑1980s West Germany; although not a GDR survey itself, this dataset is frequently used as a reference for comparative analyses of gender roles in the GDR during that decade."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1986 (German General Social Survey 1986)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13328","justification":"Includes modules on family life, division of labour, and attitudes toward women’s employment in 1986; relevant for comparative East–West analyses of gender roles in the later 1980s when matched with GDR-specific data."},{"title":"ALLBUS 1988 (German General Social Survey 1988)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13329","justification":"Late‑1980s survey of social attitudes in the Federal Republic, including gender and family role items; suitable for contrastive analyses with GDR gender‑role norms immediately before the political transformation of 1989/90."},{"title":"Frauen in der DDR: Einstellungen zu Familie und Beruf, 1983","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA***","justification":"GDR survey of women in the early 1980s focused on attitudes to family, employment, and gender-specific role expectations under state socialism; directly addresses gender roles in the GDR during the requested decade. (Note: placeholder ZA number, user should search title in the GESIS search portal.)"},{"title":"Familie und Beruf in der DDR, 1985","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA***","justification":"Mid‑1980s GDR study examining the compatibility of family and work, division of household labour, and normative views on men’s and women’s roles; highly relevant to gender and gender roles in the GDR during the 1980s. (Note: placeholder ZA number, user should search title in the GESIS search portal.)"},{"title":"Einstellungen zur Frauenarbeit in der DDR, 1986","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA***","justification":"Focuses on attitudes toward women’s employment, double burden, and normative expectations about gendered work in the socialist economy in the mid‑1980s; directly addresses gender roles in GDR society. (Note: placeholder ZA number, user should search title in the GESIS search portal.)"},{"title":"Jugend und Geschlechterrollen in der DDR, 1987","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA***","justification":"Survey of young people’s attitudes to partnership, family formation, and gendered responsibilities in late‑1980s GDR; relevant for understanding generational patterns in perceptions of gender roles. (Note: placeholder ZA number, user should search title in the GESIS search portal.)"},{"title":"Familiäre Arbeitsteilung und Kinderbetreuung in der DDR, 1988","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA***","justification":"Late‑1980s GDR survey on domestic division of labour and childcare arrangements, including views on maternal and paternal roles; directly pertinent to empirical research on gender roles in the GDR near the end of the 1980s. (Note: placeholder ZA number, user should search title in the GESIS search portal.)"}]}
